bundle.shortDescription: Wafer map viewer for semiconductor test data
bundle.longDescription: tsmap loads semiconductor wafer map data from STDF, ATDF, CSV, JSON, and Parquet files and renders interactive yield maps, parametric heat maps, bin pareto charts, per-test boxplots and histograms, and a cross-test correlation matrix. Parsing happens entirely on your own machine — there is no upload step.
